name: plan-council
author: Justin Barry
description: Multi-model plan review, critique, cross-model debate, and consensus synthesis plugin for OMP

autoStart.description: Automatically open Plan Council when a plan review opens

autoProceed.description: Automatically run critiques, debate disagreements, synthesize, and refine without manual steps

autoDebate.description: Automatically debate after Round 1 and repeat until reviewers report no disputed revisions or maxDebateRounds is reached

reviewerModels.description: Comma-separated model selectors or role names for council reviewers (empty auto-selects diverse models)

maxReviewers.description: Maximum auto-selected reviewer models when reviewerModels is empty

maxDebateRounds.description: Maximum automatic debate rounds before synthesis when autoDebate is on

synthesizerModel.description: Model selector or role name used to synthesize discussion into Refine feedback (empty uses slow role, then session model)

shortcut.description: Keybinding to open Plan Council while Plan Review is open

includeSessionContext.description: Include user prompts from the active session branch alongside the plan markdown

enableCodeReader.description: Allow council reviewers and @reader to query a shared read-only codebase subagent

readerModel.description: Model selector or role name (optional :effort suffix) for the codebase reader subagent (empty uses @council_reader, @smol, @fast, then @default)

maxReaderQueriesPerTurn.description: Maximum ask_codebase tool calls a reviewer may make per turn
